title: Floor requirement.
officialText:
Where four or more public pay telephones are provided on a floor of a privately owned building, at
least one public TTY shall be provided on that floor. Where at least one public pay telephone is provided on a floor of a publicly
owned building, at least one public TTY shall be provided on that floor.
